title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, delivering a powerful and refined experience to help you achieve your goals.

title: Complete Control Over Your Editor Files
summary: Experience superior control over your editor's files, enabling effortless uploading, removal, downloading, and flexible display options for all your media.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap page to discover recently shipped features, upcoming releases, and exciting plans for the future of our product.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Get ready for a smoother experience with our updated checkboxes, now bigger, easier to drag, and beautifully integrated into your workspace.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Experience enhanced team collaboration in our editor, now with clearer indicators to ensure everyone stays perfectly in sync while working together.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Shared Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and collaborate on shared items, connecting you more seamlessly with your network and ideas.

title: Worldwide Language Access
summary: Noeko now embraces a global audience with comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, making your experience more personal.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, inviting our community to directly contribute, gain full transparency, and shape the future of the project together.

title: Supercharge Your Knowledge Map
summary: Gain powerful new ways to navigate and utilize your knowledge map by filtering connections based on tags, time, and shared items, turning it into your ultimate tool for exploration and workflow initiation.

title: Enhanced Search and Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Discover and organize your knowledge with powerful new filters, flexible sorting options, and the ability to save custom collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Effortlessly organize and interact with your linked content through flexible new viewing modes designed to mirror your unique thought process, making your notes more intuitive and powerful.

title: Noeko Unleashed: Self-Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Experience Noeko your way with upcoming self-hosting capabilities and new premium plans designed to empower both individual users and growing enterprises.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Enhanced and New Themes
summary: Transform your experience with a vibrant collection of beautifully refined existing themes and exciting new visual options.

title: Experience Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and delightful welcome, as your homepage greetings will now beautifully align with the current time of day wherever you are.

title: Quick Actions for Tag Views
summary: Efficiently manage your tagged content by performing quick actions like unapplying tags and deleting items directly from their list views, significantly boosting your productivity.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to centralize all your essential information within the platform.
